eyebrow: ydata-profiling: a report in a few lines
code:
from ydata_profiling import (
    ProfileReport)

profile = ProfileReport(
    customers,
    title="Customer profile")
profile.to_file(
    "customer_profile.html")
caption: Ran with ydata-profiling 4.6.4 on the practice data.

code:
import sweetviz as sv

train = customers[:350]
test = customers[350:]
cmp = sv.compare(
    [train, "Train"], [test, "Test"],
    target_feat="churned")
cmp.show_html("compare.html",
              open_browser=False)
caption: Ran with Sweetviz 2.3.3. Check current docs.
